title: Manipulating charge carrier interactions at solid electrolyte interfaces for enhanced micro-supercapacitor performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21794-21802
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02402A, Paper
Open Access

Abhirami Sukumaran, Premkumar Jayaraman, Helen Annal Therese
Symmetric device SS‖PVA-LiClO4 + Li2SO4‖SS, with Li2SO4 additive, improved interfacial charge dynamics, boosting volumetric capacitance (11.8 F cm−3), energy density (1.6 mWh cm−3), and stability (83% after 2000 cycles), while suppressing dendrites.
